reply_text:
Bettina, I can't set up a recurring Monday 08:00 digest. I have no scheduling tool, so I can't post the "Coastal week ahead" automatically.

What I can do is post it on request. If you ask me here on a Monday, I'll pull the previous week from #coastal-team and #coastal-random, plus the open customer items, and post the digest in this channel. For a fully automatic weekly post, someone with scheduling access will need to set up that job.
